scope: Two disjoint label-free reviews of 60 original fictional cases each, without candidate outputs or gold. Primary-label agreement is fixture review, not model performance. Four ambiguity flags remain unresolved; original labels and wording are preserved.

cases.rationale: The striped-handle basket belongs to the five; each has a peach and none has plums.
Stone Lantern immediately followed the opener, and Uvressa explicitly did not perform in it.
The banner location gives no information about portraits.
08:30 is half an hour after the stated 08:00 opening.
Signing and inspection are stated, but their temporal order is not.
Forecasting next-day flooding paraphrases the explicitly attributed prediction.
Delivery destination is given, but mode of travel is not.
The rules establish latch release, not door movement.
A closed drawer need not be locked; no lock status is supplied.
The actual 19:30 start differs from the unchanged advertised 19:00 time.
The closed stock accounting gives nine plus five minus six, leaving eight finished lanterns.
The advertised 19:00 time precedes the confirmed 19:30 start by thirty minutes.
The two observations do not establish the flame status at 14:30.
The eight sacks in R and seven in S all went onto the wagon, with no other sacks: fifteen total.
Jesvra is the unique assigned courier, and that courier delivered K47 to the observatory on Tuesday.
K47 was delivered to the hill observatory and nowhere else that day, excluding the harbor warehouse.
A broken seal would have required setting Tavren aside; compliance and its not being set aside exclude a broken seal.
Corvinel made the statement, but the passage explicitly does not verify the well contents.
The passage explicitly says no east-gallery painting depicted a boat.
Painting on day 4 precedes hanging on day 6 of the same fair.
Neither of the two Monday crossings was late.
The fruitless trees are counted but not assigned to rows.
The banner explicitly remained on the north wall throughout the ceremony.
The flame was explicitly burning at the 14:00 check.
Three rows of seven and no other pear trees give twenty-one, not twenty-four.
No audience reaction is stated.
The sold lanterns are not identified as original versus newly completed stock.
At sunrise the chest was explicitly in the cellar and not the upstairs room.
Flight of Reeds was the opener, and Uvressa played its solo that evening.
The log confirms every crew member wore a life belt on that voyage, excluding a crew member going without one.
The guaranteed lever-to-bell rule and the actual lever pull establish a ring, contradicting silence throughout.
Noon falls within the stated continuous open period from 11:00 until 18:00.
Nothing specifies the contents of Tavren.
The repair explicitly did not replace the hands.
The prohibition is inside the pavilion; no rule addresses instruments in the garden outside.
Speaking the correct word guarantees a green lamp, which guarantees latch release during the visit.
Each person occupied a specified separate building during the roll call.
Eight plus seven sacks, all and only those loaded, gives fifteen rather than fourteen.
Nollis was in the courtyard, which lies entirely within the outer wall.
Keressa explicitly made no flooding prediction at the session.
Corvinel explicitly stated that the northern well was empty at the gathering.
10:15 falls inside the uninterrupted closure interval from 09:00 to before 11:00.
The quoted statement describes the well as empty without requiring its contents to be verified.
Four of the six couriers explicitly carried no whistles.
No weather information is supplied.
The narrator verifies she did not hide the amber key, so she did not hide both keys.
Arrival and archive locking times do not establish the visitor departure time.
Ilset explicitly did not inspect the furnace; Rozen alone performed the afternoon inspection.
The clerk heard the report, but the clerk belief is unstated.
Selnara reported red; the narrator verifies blue and explicitly identifies her color mistake.
The records identify Evening Reed as made by Theslin and located in the west cabinet throughout opening day.
The universally obeyed broken-seal rule and Tavren not being set aside entail that its seal was not broken.
Cup damage and counts are stated, but colors are not.
Repair without replacement of the hands means the clock retained its existing hands.
Dreska remained in the smithy, whose interior is disjoint from the bakery.
Navren explicitly did not prohibit flutes inside the pavilion.
The only banner was on the north wall, a different opposite wall from the south wall.
The narrator explicitly confirms the mill was still open at sunset and identifies the diary claim as erroneous.
Hanging on day 6 follows, rather than precedes, completion of carving on day 3.
The content of the diary entry does not establish when it was written.
The second recorded check was at 15:00, when the flame was out.
There were eight undamaged and four chipped cups in the crate; eight is twice four.
Pulling the copper lever guarantees ringing, and Fesrik pulled it during the trial.
The narrator confirms both that she hid the silver key and that she did not hide the amber key.
Contents and counts do not establish relative envelope sizes.
Navren explicitly did not prohibit flutes inside the pavilion.
The disjoint map and ticket categories contain three plus two, or five envelopes, not seven.
No varnishing event or activity on day 5 is stated.
The closed stock accounting gives nine plus five minus six, or eight lanterns, not fourteen.
The compass is inside a drawer in a room inside the western tower.
Ilset did not inspect the furnace, and Rozen alone performed the inspection; this supports the ordinary nonparticipation reading of leaving it to someone else.

ambiguity_flags.detail: Left the inspection to someone else can imply a deliberate choice or delegation. Nonparticipation plus another person inspecting does not explicitly establish that agency; primary label uses the ordinary weaker nonparticipation reading.

cases.rationale: The maker is recorded but no creation date is supplied.
Neither the title nor the exclusion of boats establishes a person among trees.
Pralith predicted flooding; the account does not verify that the prediction came true.
Printing on day 1 precedes the exhibition ending on day 9, rather than following it.
The diary gives sunset, and the narrator explicitly calls that claim erroneous and confirms later opening.
Arrival punctuality supplies no passenger counts.
The glove rule covers north-kiln apprentices only; south-kiln clothing is unspecified.
Pulling the copper lever does not establish pulling a wooden lever.
Earning a ribbon does not establish the antecedent of a sufficient-only reading rule.
At least one peach does not determine exactly two peaches.
Winter Orchard belongs to the east-gallery paintings, none of which depicted a boat.
Hiding the key does not establish later retrieval.
Both can swim, but no distances or relative ability are stated.
The purchase cost is known, but her initial funds and remaining coins are not.
Separate locations establish neither visibility nor its absence.
Six lengths at four coins each, with exact payment and no adjustment, gives twenty-four coins.
Speaking the correct word triggers green, which in turn guarantees latch release.
The narrator explicitly confirms the observed sail was blue, not red.
The first visitor entered at 08:30, after opening at 08:00.
The chest was still in her upstairs room at 13:00.
The single compass was in the western tower, whose space is disjoint from the eastern tower.
The morning crossing was early and the evening crossing on time, so neither was late.
All six couriers carried satchels, and four explicitly carried no whistles.
The passage directly states the vent was closed and the sensor dry at 10:00.
Nollis sat in the courtyard, which has no overlap with the riverbank.
Luvira earned a ribbon, ordinarily meaning she won or was awarded one, contrary to receiving no ribbon.

ambiguity_flags.detail: Earned a ribbon normally means won or was awarded it, but can mean became entitled to a ribbon not yet received. Literal receipt is not separately stated.

cases.rationale: Four of twelve cups were chipped, one third rather than one half.
Printing date does not establish a distribution date.
Senva was among the north-kiln apprentices, all of whom wore gloves during firing.
The statement that Luvira earned a ribbon ordinarily establishes that she won or was awarded one.

ambiguity_flags.detail: Earned a ribbon normally means won or was awarded it, but can mean became entitled to a ribbon not yet received. Literal receipt is not separately stated.

cases.rationale: The inventory and loading records give sack counts, not weights or weight equality.
The account explicitly supplies no information about work on the bell.
The striped-handle basket was on the quay, and no basket there contained a plum.
The exhibition record locates the single bowl in the west cabinet throughout opening day; east and west interiors are disjoint.
Senva was in the group explicitly wearing gloves during the firing.
Carrying a satchel does not establish that it contained a letter.
Exactly five of the ten envelopes were empty, which is half.
The catalog was printed on day 1, before the exhibition began on day 2.
Location alone gives no evidence of river audibility.
Exact payment was six times four, or twenty-four coins, rather than twenty.
Esvyn was a team member and explicitly could not swim.
Exactly four members minus the one nonswimmer gives three swimmers.
Uvressa is identified as the performer, not the composer.
The sensor was explicitly dry at 10:00, despite the closed vent; the conditional does not reverse.
The roster places Malessa among the Monday crew, and the voyage log confirms every such crew member wore a life belt.
The account specifies the bridge state from 09:00 onward, not at 08:00.
The location of Ervessa's chest does not establish Ervessa's own location.
On the ordinary exact-count reading of two fruitless trees out of twenty-one, the other nineteen bore fruit.

ambiguity_flags.detail: Two of the twenty-one trees bore no fruit naturally reports the complete count, but unlike other numerical clauses it does not say exactly two or explicitly that the others bore fruit. A lower-bound reading leaves the claim unestablished.

cases.rationale: The dry sensor and closed vent do not identify who closed the vent or how.
